# Ruby

Type: Valuable | Internal ID: Ruby | Source: Burial Chambers, Sunken Crypts, Chest | Usage: Building, Crafting, Selling to a, Trader | Sell: 20, Coins | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Ruby is a Valuable item.

## Availability

• Stone Grave and Viking Graveyard in the Meadows.
• Burial Chambers in the Black Forest.
• Sunken Crypts in the Swamp.
• Loot chests inside Frost Caves in the Mountain.
• Chests around the surface that are placed inside various points of interest, like towers or ruined houses.
• Ruby can be obtained from Fishing, as a bonus drop when catching Tuna.

### Building

• Treasure chest

### Crafting

• Bronze Pendant

### Selling

• As a valuable, it can be sold to any of the traders for 20 Coins.

Categorias: Valuables
